name: Bludit Wizard
description: AI-assisted writing, editing, SEO analysis, and content management for Bludit CMS, featuring twelve guided tasks and human-reviewed changes.

features.0: Twelve guided tasks for writing, editing, proofreading, SEO analysis, metadata, internal links, content freshness and contextual questions.
features.1: Human review before changes: generated content is editable and is saved only when Apply this change is pressed.
features.2: Read-only audits for SEO and clarity, internal links and content freshness never modify pages.
features.3: Existing-page selection with task-specific instructions and contextual primary action labels.
features.4: Original and proposed content shown side by side, with stale-edit protection.
features.5: Configurable OpenAI-compatible providers, searchable model discovery, optional free-model and tool filters, and model testing.
features.6: Model discovery and testing verified with OpenRouter and LLM Gateway; other compatible providers may work.
features.7: No page deletion, CSRF/authorization checks, protected API keys and SSRF-aware provider requests.
